Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original small tactical-RPG job emblem, production candidate for ProjectTactic's Squire job.
Primary request: Paint a single bold upright short sword with a compact simple crossguard and dark navy wrapped grip, blade pointing upward. The clear broad blade silhouette is the entire emblem. Add a narrow cream cloth wrap around the grip only. It communicates a disciplined reliable fighter.
Style: hand-painted 2.5D fantasy inventory icon, original artwork, crisp silhouette, simplified broad planes, subtle worn steel, aged-brass fittings, warm ivory highlights and restrained lavender-grey shadow. Match the grounded painterly material vocabulary of a cream-stone, lavender-shadow tactical RPG, with soft upper-left lighting.
Composition: square 1024 x 1024 image; one centered isolated object, occupying about 76 percent of canvas height with generous transparent margin. Near-frontal view with just enough shallow depth to read as a painted object, not a flat vector logo. Balanced for a 32 px job button. Use broad clear forms and thick details that survive reduction.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA outside the object; no plate, badge, shield, frame, background, letters, typography, numbers, logo, watermark, sparkle, cast shadow, halo, stage or secondary object. Do not create a sheet. This is one standalone icon.
